script_text: Stop! Pisces, Neptune, your watery ruler, is rewriting your money story. On November 16, 2026, Neptune in Aries sits in your 2nd House of income, sextile Pluto in your 12th House of hidden resources. Saturn in Aries also presses your 2nd House, making every dollar feel heavier, while your Water element feels the emotional tide. Venus in your 9th House squares Mars in your 6th, so love needs honest words, not silent sacrifice; single Pisces, attract someone who respects your rituals, and taken Pisces, schedule a real conversation instead of testing them. For career, the Sun in your 9th House squares Mars in your 6th, so avoid overpromising and finish one practical task with clean numbers. Blessing: a quiet insight may become extra income; avoid lending or signing before you decide, and read the fine print. Follow for tomorrow’s reading.
